title: Gritrunner
description:
GRITRUNNER
A fast-paced neon arcade space game where you dodge enemy fire, collect wreckage, and survive escalating encounters. You play as a Gritrunner, an indentured pilot working for one of the megacorporations that control the galaxy. You are sent into the worst parts of the galaxy to clean up their mess and pay off your debt. You’re getting close now. A few more jobs and you’re free. This arcade-inspired game has you piloting a ship, collecting wreckage, and avoiding an onslaught of enemy fire.
description_short: Gritrunner is a neon arcade space game. Dodge enemies and their fire. Collect the wreckage. Get out if you can.
